positions.title: Growth Manager
positions.description:
Driving growth with data-driven marketing strategies and full-funnel expertise.
As a Growth Manager at Adverlise, I oversee diverse marketing projects, guiding businesses through every stage of the funnel. From paid media and lead generation to marketing automation, conversion rate optimization, and analytics, I focus on crafting innovative strategies that drive results. By combining cutting-edge tools with actionable insights, I help organizations enhance customer engagement, optimize processes, and achieve sustainable growth.

Key Areas of Expertise:

•	Marketing Automation & Optimization: Proficient in tools like HubSpot, ActiveCampaign, and Make for scalable solutions.
•	Lead Generation & Funnel Management: Crafting seamless, high-converting customer journeys.
•	Data Analytics & Reporting: Skilled in tools such as Google Analytics and Microsoft Clarity.
•	Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO): A/B testing and iterative improvements for measurable growth.
•	Digital Strategy & Paid Media: Driving impactful campaigns across multiple channels.
•	Customer Insights & Research: Translating user behavior into actionable strategies.
•	Tracking & Compliance: Expert in advanced tracking implementations, including server-side solutions.
